issue_context.title: Crash when screen is locked and monitor goes into power-saving mode
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the bug / provide steps to reproduce it I found a [similar crash report](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5951) but since that was for Mac and this is for Linux, I figured I'd open a new one. To reproduce, all I have to do is start Zed and lock my screen. If I immediately unlock my machine Zed is still running with no problems, but if I am gone long enough for my external monitor to go into power-saving mode, then when I unlock my machine Zed is gone. This happens the vast majority of the time, though there have been a small handful of times (i.e. 3 or 4 times over the last few months) Zed was still running when I unlocked my machine. The attached log is from about 10 minutes after I locked my computer, which is my current timeout for power-saving mode. ### Environment Zed: v0.143.4 (Zed Preview) OS: Linux X11 ubuntu 24.04 Memory: 31 GiB Architecture: x86_64 My laptop is a Dell Precision 5570 with a NVIDIA RTX A1000 Laptop GPU/PCIe/SSE2. I am using proprietary drivers (`nvidia-driver-535`). I have it plugged in to an external 4K monitor which is where Zed runs. ### If applicable, attach your `~/Library/Logs/Zed/Zed.log` file to this issue.
